newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ANGLO GFSA CALL DEELKRAAL CONFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: ANGLO GFSA CALL DEELKRAAL CONFERENCE.

text.p: Anglo American Corporation of South Africa Ltd and Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd Tuesday called a joint media conference concerning Deelkraal Gold Mining Co Ltd .
"It is an Anglo-Gold Fields media conference concerning Deelkraal," an Anglo spokeswoman said.
The conference was scheduled for 1400 GMT.
Earlier this month Gold Field's Deelkraal and Anglo's Elandsrand Gold Mining Co Ltd issued a further joint cautionary announcement to shareholders.
The two gold mines have been in talks since last August with regard to a possible tie-up.
